A [[human]] '''patrol trooper''' of the [[Galactic Empire]] was present on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] in [[13 BBY]].<ref name="SoloDate">{{FilmDate|Solo}}</ref> In that [[Standard year|year]], he witnessed [[Han Solo]] and his lover, [[Qi'ra]], speeding in their [[M-68 landspeeder]] as they were being pursued by an [[A-A4B truckspeeder]] [[pilot]]ed by the [[White Worms]] [[gangster]] [[Moloch]]. The trooper then began chasing the two [[landspeeder]]s on his [[C-PH patrol speeder bike]]; however, the others were able to escape as the trooper crashed his speeder shortly afterward.<ref name="Solo" />
